messages:
sam: hi team, onboarding snag  I tried to create a new page from the Engineering template but Notion gave me view-only. Do we have a special step for new hires to get edit perms?

devex: hey sam, welcome! :wave: new hires should get default edit access to team templates, but sometimes the sync fails. can you paste your employee ID and manager (or DM us) so we can look?

sam: emp-2024-119, manager @kevin. i did try the 'request access' button but it timed out.

maria: we saw a short outage yesterday where the Notion connector to SSO dropped for a couple hours. if you used SSO on your first login during that window you might be missing some group grants. devex can re-run the grant script.

onboarding-bot: Notion SSO reconnect detected for user sam (emp-2024-119).

devex: thanks, sam. re-running the group grant now. you should see edit perms in ~5 minutes. if not, DM me and I'll do a manual grant.

sam: still view-only after 10 mins.

devex: okay trying manual grant. what's the page path you're trying to duplicate?

sam: Engineering  Templates / New Feature Spec Template

kevin: FYI devex, my new hire needs to be able to duplicate the spec template today for a kickoff.

devex: manual grant done. please refresh the page, and try duplicating again.

sam: duplication worked! thanks. quick question: where should I put the spec after I copy it? team space or org templates?

maria: if it's specific to the eng team and has implementation notes, put it under Engineering  Projects  <team-name>. if it's a generic pattern that other teams could reuse, propose it to Redwood Docs  Templates and ping devex for promotion.

sam: got it. one more dumb newbie question: what naming convention do we use for drafts?

devex: we usually use: <project>-<page-type>-<initials>-YYYYMMDD e.g. payments-spec-ss-20240320. when promoting to main templates remove initials and date and add a changelog.

kevin: adding: please add a one-line summary at the top for quick search results. helps PMs find specs fast.

sam: awesome, thanks everyone :smile:

onboarding-bot: Reminder: complete onboarding docs checklist: Notion tour, Set up two-factor, request access to team repos.
